summary: Preregistered paired confirmatory study (n=300 paired tasks) comparing a generate–validate–repair (G‑V‑R) pipeline against direct LLM generation for vendor CLI fragments. Design froze a single shared initial generation per task; baseline = validator(initial), guarded = validator(initial) or one automatic repair if initial failed. All 300 shared initial candidates passed the conservative deterministic validator (baseline = 300/300; guarded = 300/300), so the single‑repair stage was never invoked. Paired contingency n11=300, n10=n01=n00=0; paired difference = 0.00; exact McNemar two‑sided p=1.00; bootstrap 95% CI = [0.00,0.00] (10k resamples, seed=1729). Artifacts (task manifest, provider traces, responses, validator traces, analysis artifacts) are archived with full SHA‑256 hashes.
required_revisions: Explicitly report the preregistered secondary per‑vendor analyses: either (a) present per‑vendor paired contingency counts (n11,n10,n01,n00) computed from the archived artifacts and state the (non)results, or (b) transparently state that the preregistered per‑vendor paired tests were not informative/executed because there were zero discordant pairs and explain this fact. Cite the exact artifact paths and hashes used to compute any added counts. This is required because the preregistration specified per‑vendor secondary tests but the analysis bundle contains no secondary_results; the manuscript must transparently reconcile that preregistered plan with the archived outcomes (resolvable from provided artifacts).
optional_revisions: Add a concise table or one‑paragraph summary giving the vendor distribution (counts of tasks by vendor) drawn directly from the canonical task_manifest.jsonl (artifact path and SHA already provided). This will help readers quickly assess external validity without requiring them to reprocess the manifest.

In Related Work, replace informal group citations (e.g., "Nguyen et al. 2024") with precise, verified citations (DOI/arXiv/venue) where missing; ensure every cited work listed in the manuscript appears in the verified bibliography record (artifact paths are available).

Briefly expand the Threats to Validity paragraph to note that the shared‑initial design trades estimator interpretability for sensitivity to ceiling effects and to recommend explicitly which follow‑ups (independent initial draws per arm, harder task slices, increased repair budget) should be rerun to probe regimes where repairs might help.
